title: Sloppy looking. Lots of loose threads
text: Sloppy looking. Lots of loose threads. These are okay for the money. They are thick but because of that have a look almost akin to a stuffed animal. A surprising amount of errant threads! All over the towel. They absorb water fine. They didn’t shrink after washing.

product_metadata.title: MADISON PARK SIGNATURE Luxor 100% Egyptian Cotton Luxurious Bath Towel Set, Silky Soft, Highly Absorbent, Premium Spa Quality, Multi-Sizes, White 6 Piece
features: Treat yourself with this luxurious towel set made with Gold Seal Certified 100% Egyptian Cotton Towel Set.
Featuring 650gsm consturction of gold seal certified 100% Egyptian Cotton, this incredibly soft towel set ensures the premium quality and heavy weight for extra comfor.
This quality towel set is Oeko-tex certified; it is produced with no chemicals and harmful substance while using sustainable processes and socially responsible working conditions.
2 Bath Towels: 30"W x 54"L, 2 Hand Towels: 16"W x 26"L, 2 Washcloths: 13"W x 13"L

Care instructions: Wash before first use. Machine wash warm on gentle cycle with like colors. Only use non-chlorine bleach when needed. Avoid contact with products containing benzoyl peroxide. Do not wash with sharp items that may pull the towel fibers, such as zippers or hooks. To maintain the quality and performance of your towels, avoid the use of fabric softeners and dry sheets. Tumble dry low, remove promptly. Do not iron. Before use, simply shake towels to restore fluff and pile.
description: Treat yourself with the luxurious comfort of our Madison Park Signature Luxor 100% Egyptian Cotton 6 Piece Towel Set. The long staple cotton yarn creates a rich plush softness, for a glamorous look and silk-like feel. Made from gold seal certified 100% Egyptian cotton, this towel set features 650gsm construction that ensures a premium quality and heavy weight for pure comfort. In addition, these towels are also Made in Green by OEKO-TEX certified, meaning they do not contain any harmful substances or chemicals while also using sustainable processes and socially responsible working conditions, ensuring the best in quality and wellness. With its incredibly soft touch, this 6 piece bath towel set is machine washable for easy care and offers the perfect lavish update to your bathroom decor. Set includes: 2 large 30x54" bath towels, 2 standard 16x26" hand towels, and 2 standard 13x13" wash towels.
